user.title: Engelsoft Beacon BACnet/IP
user.description:
This integration requires the Engelsoft BACstac app or an external BACstac gateway. Install and start BACstac before continuing.

[BACstac installation / GitHub repository]({bacstac_repository_url})

app_unavailable.title: BACstac could not be reached
app_unavailable.description:
The local Engelsoft BACstac app could not be reached. Install and start it, then search again. If it is already running, check its logs and whether port 8099 is reachable. Alternatively, configure an external gateway.

[BACstac installation / GitHub repository]({bacstac_repository_url})

app_incompatible.title: Incompatible BACstac version
app_incompatible.description:
A local gateway was reached, but it does not support the required Engelsoft BACstac Protocol V2. Update BACstac and the integration together, then search again.

[BACstac installation / GitHub repository]({bacstac_repository_url})

error.unsupported_gateway: Incompatible gateway version. Please update BACstac and the integration.

app_unavailable.title: Engelsoft BACstac unavailable
app_unavailable.description: Engelsoft BACstac or the external gateway cannot be reached. Check that it is running and port 8099 is reachable.

gateway_incompatible.title: Incompatible BACstac version
gateway_incompatible.description: The gateway requires Protocol V2. Update BACstac and the integration together.
